info.title: web-jam-back API
info.description: The API specification of web-jam-back. Every authenticated route first runs the login check: the bearer token must be valid and name an existing user, and the user's role must pass the route's AUTH_ROLES entry when one is set; a failure there answers 401. The capability check follows. A caller whose user record carries a privileges list must hold one of the capabilities named in x-required-capabilities; a caller with no list must have the role JaM-admin or Developer; anyone else is answered 403 and nothing is written. A caller tied to one artist (an artist slug on the account) may write only that artist's gigs, and is answered 403 otherwise.

get.description: Public. With no artist parameter, or artist=jammusic, returns the original artist's gigs, including records with no artist field. Any other query parameter filters on that field.

post.description: The artist is stamped on the record: forced to the caller's artist when the caller is tied to one, otherwise taken from the body, defaulting to jammusic. Any _id in the body is ignored.

500.description: Storage refused the gig, for example "Gig validation failed: venue: Path `venue` is required."

get.description: Public. The image the announce route falls back to when a gig has none.

get.summary: Public padded-JPEG image that Instagram fetches
get.description: Public. Serves the gig announce image converted to JPEG and padded to an allowed Instagram aspect ratio (4:5 to 1.91:1) without cropping.

502.description: Source image could not be fetched or read.

400.description: "Find id is invalid" or "nothing found with id provided".

put.description: Applies the body to the gig and returns the gig as it stands after the edit. A caller tied to one artist may edit only that artist's gigs and may not move a gig to another artist.

400.description: "Update id is invalid" or "Id Not Found".

delete.description: Deletes the one gig named by id, for example a cancelled gig or one added by mistake. A caller tied to one artist may delete only that artist's gigs.

400.description: "id is invalid" or "Delete id is invalid" (no gig has that id).

post.summary: Announce a gig on the Josh Sherman Instagram
post.description: Converts the caption to plain text, saves the chosen image source as announceImageUrl, and publishes the public /gig/{id}/announce-image.jpg with tags and collaborators through Instagram v25.0. A failed media request with a location is retried once without it before waiting and publishing. Success sets announcedAt and appends the time and chosen image source to announcements. The image source is imageUrl, else promoImageUrl, else /gig/promo-default.jpg.

caption.description: The caption as editor HTML; it is converted to plain text.

collaborators.description: Up to three public Instagram usernames without @. Omission or an empty list sends no collaborators.

locationId.description: Facebook Page ID for the Instagram location. Omission or an empty string sends no location. A rejected location is dropped on one retry.

userTags.description: Maria username first (x=0.25), venue username second (x=0.75); y=0.85. Empty strings clear a tag while preserving positions. Omitted means no tags.

200.description: The Instagram publish result, including Instagram error text on refusal.

400.description: Invalid gig id, caption, imageUrl, userTags, collaborators or locationId, or gig not found.

500.description: Instagram announce is not configured, or its key or gig could not be read, or the image source could not be saved.

post.summary: Create or update a matching venue
post.description: Matches an existing venue by name, city and normalized street address, otherwise creates a new record. instagramUsername is checked before writes: only letters, numbers, periods and underscores, at most 30 characters, without @. Empty string clears it; omission leaves an existing username unchanged. Operator and dotted updates targeting instagramUsername are refused.

400.description: Invalid venue fields, including instagramUsername; nothing is written.

patch.description: Merges only the submitted fields into the selected venue. instagramUsername is checked before writes: only letters, numbers, periods and underscores, at most 30 characters, without @. Empty string clears it; omission leaves an existing username unchanged. Operator and dotted updates targeting instagramUsername are refused.

400.description: Invalid venue fields, including instagramUsername; nothing is written.

200.description: The venue, including instagramUsername when set.

400.description: Invalid or unknown venue id.

bearerAuth.description: A web-jam-back login token. Browser logins expire after 24 hours; agent service tokens do not expire.

NotLoggedIn.description: No valid token, no user for it, or the user's role is not allowed on this route.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the capability (for example "missing gig:edit/tour:edit capability"), has no privileges list and is not JaM-admin or Developer, or is tied to a different artist ("not authorized for this artist").

id.description: The published post's id, when ok.

error.description: Why the publish failed, when not ok.

locationDropped.description: The first media request's error when the post was successfully published after retrying without its requested location.

artist.description: Artist slug; records without one belong to jammusic.

announcements.description: Successful Instagram posts, appended in order. Absent on gigs without recorded history.

imageUrl.description: The chosen image source, not the public JPEG route.

announceImageUrl.description: The chosen source image saved for the public announce JPEG route.

title.description: Required when songId is not set

VenueUpdateInput.description: Partial venue fields; other existing venue fields are also accepted.

facebookPageId.description: Optional Facebook Page ID for Instagram location tagging, stored as digits. Empty string clears it; omission preserves the stored value on updates.

instagramUsername.description: Optional Instagram username without @. Empty string clears the username; omission preserves the stored value on updates.

AssetUpdateInput.description: Partial asset fields for updates; all fields are optional.

SongPublic.description: Explicit public music-page fields. No rights or recording records are returned.

Song.description: Authenticated catalog record; rights remain optional until independently verified, for the applicable song category. No recording or URL is required.

artist.description: Artist slug for artist-scoped admins. Absent for super-admins and ordinary users.
